address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the touchscreen controller. Defaults to `0x55`.

*See also: [st7123 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/st7123#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually set the ID of this touchscreen.

*See also: [st7123 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/st7123#configuration-variables)*

interrupt_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The touch detection pin. When connected directly to an MCU GPIO, the driver uses it for interrupt-driven operation; otherwise it falls back to polling.

*See also: [st7123 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/st7123#configuration-variables)*

reset_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The chip reset pin.

*See also: [st7123 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/st7123#configuration-variables)*
